recommendation: Keep the core audit commit. If further cleanup is desired, update HL7/fhir-extensions so StructureDefinition.description also matches the already-updated Extension differential and the extension landing page no longer repeats the old code-generation wording.
issue_request: FHIR-51990 was Applied with a Not Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. It asked to correct the elementdefinition-bindingName extension because its code-generation description implied a globally useful enumeration name even though binding names are not globally unique; the accepted change was to describe it as a rendering/table summary name and add same-StructureDefinition consistency guidance.
initial_application: No FHIR-core source commit applies the requested extension-definition wording. HL7/fhir-extensions commit 0569c81135610c9757d2598070f8946de7847e96 applies the issue in the Extension Pack by changing the Extension differential short, definition, and comment to the approved wording and note.
additional_context: The Jira comment says the issue is in the extensions pack, the FHIR-core checkout has no source/fhir.ini entry or StructureDefinition source file for elementdefinition-bindingName, and the implementer Zulip thread plus FHIR-I minutes support the clarification. The current Extension Pack CI JSON still has the old top-level StructureDefinition.description while the Extension snapshot carries the approved definition/comment, so any remaining cleanup is in HL7/fhir-extensions.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined FHIR-core branch and made no core source changes.
